hedges.reason: Hyperliquid is the purest high-beta bet on speculative crypto flows and exchange-token demand. The window runs from market creation to year-end, which overlaps the Q4 2026 period when a hot Ink launch would happen. If crypto is risk-on enough to push Ink above $1B FDV, HYPE should touch at least the nearest upside rung.

XRP is a large-cap alt that retail and exchange flows move. Its window runs from market creation to year-end. The broad alt rally that would lift a new L2 token listing should also carry XRP to its nearest upside rung.

OpenSea is another high-profile, well-funded crypto company airdropping a token under the same year-end deadline. In the same demand and liquidity conditions that would support a rich Ink FDV, OpenSea would also be more likely to launch and to price well on day one. It is the nearest like-for-like instrument, but it can also lose simply because OpenSea does not launch.

claims.reason: Ink clearing $1B FDV one day after launch requires both a launch before Dec 31 and strong speculative bids for new tokens. Both depend on a liquid, risk-on crypto market in Q4 2026. That same market lifts high-beta exchange tokens like HYPE, so HYPE should touch its nearest upside rung by year-end.

A $2B+ day-one FDV for a mid-tier L2 has historically needed broad alt-season conditions. Retail and exchange inflows then spread across large-cap alts, so XRP would be expected to touch its nearest upside rung within the same window.
